items.job: Replace lower and upper intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: Owners on CarComplaints report about $1,400 on average when other parts were done at the same time.

items.job: Replace head gaskets (both sides) and machine heads as needed
items.note: Cost climbs if a head is cracked or warped. On an older vehicle, a used engine can be cheaper.

items.t: Engine overheating and hot warning light
items.job: Diagnose overheating and replace thermostat or water pump
items.note: Price is for the common fixes. A cracked head or blown gasket costs far more.

items.job: Replace 4T65-E transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $2,700 on average. A valve body repair alone costs much less if caught early.

items.t: Erratic shifting from pressure control solenoid
items.job: Replace transmission pressure control solenoid
Replace second clutch assembly (transmission partly disassembled)
items.note: Labor is high because the transmission must come apart.

items.job: Replace one wheel hub bearing assembly
Replace fuel pump module with fuel level sender
Repair instrument cluster or replace and program engine computer
items.note: A cluster rebuild is the cheaper end; a new PCM is the high end.

items.job: Replace A/C compressor, dryer and recharge
items.note: A leak repair or blend door actuator costs much less.

items.t: Water pump and heater pipe coolant leaks
items.job: Replace water pump or heater supply pipe and refill coolant
Replace fuel pump module

items.t: Camshaft timing codes on the 3.6L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: If the cause is only a sensor or wiring, the repair costs much less.

items.t: EGR valve codes keep coming back
items.job: Clean or replace EGR valve
items.note: An owner reported $200 to $280 for EGR work.

items.t: AWD warning light and rear drive problems
items.job: Diagnose AWD system and replace sensor or rear drive part
items.note: Wide range: a sensor is cheap, while a rear drive unit or transfer case is expensive.

items.job: Replace window regulator and motor

items.t: Engine may stall or not restart from ignition relay (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition relay
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.job: Inspect and replace steering intermediate shaft
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Liftgate could open in a crash (recall)
items.job: Add liftgate latch reinforcements
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Fuel tank check valve can leak (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace fuel tank
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Passenger airbag may turn on or off wrongly (recall)
items.job: Repair passenger sensing system
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.
